FIELDS.NAME: Beverage Haven Distributors
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Beverage Haven Distributors specializes in the wholesale distribution of a wide variety of alcoholic beverages, including beer, liquor, and wine. We operate with a strong commitment to compliance, ensuring that all aspects of our business adhere to federal, state, and local alcohol licensing regulations. Our operations include sourcing products from licensed manufacturers and wholesalers, maintaining robust inventory management systems, and implementing strict age verification and responsible beverage service training for all staff to prevent underage sales. With a focus on operational excellence, we prioritize security measures to protect our significant inventory levels. We also ensure that our business personal property is covered at 100% replacement cost to mitigate risks associated with theft or loss. Our commitment to excellence extends to ongoing staff training and proactive management of seasonal inventory adjustments based on historical sales data, ensuring we meet customer demand while minimizing potential liabilities.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Beverage Bliss Distributors, LLC - Specialty Wine Retailers
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In March 2022, we experienced a loss due to a break-in at our distribution center where assorted alcoholic beverages worth $10,000 were stolen. Our security systems were functioning at the time, but we are still enhancing our protocols to prevent future incidents. This loss has been reported, and we have recovered $5,000 through insurance claims, with the remaining amount still pending resolution. We are actively working with law enforcement to address the situation.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade IV, Locked Vault - High Security
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system with regular monitoring and security patrols.
FIELDS.G1: Do/have past, present or discontinue: No – Our operations do not involve storing, treating, discharging, applying, disposing, or transporting hazardous materials. We are focused solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages and adhere strictly to safety and compliance standards.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: No – We do not currently sponsor athletic teams as part of our marketing strategy at Beverage Haven Distributors. Our focus remains on compliance and operational excellence in the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Sub-contractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The compliance officer, John Smith, checks the certificates to ensure that all necessary insurance requirements are met.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – There have been no indictments or convictions related to fraud, bribery, arson, or any other arson-related crime for any applicant connected to Beverage Haven Distributors. We maintain a strong commitment to compliance and ethical operations.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – There have been no policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior 3 years for Beverage Haven Distributors. We maintain a strong compliance record and have not faced any insurance issues.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – We do not lease employees to or from other employers. Our workforce is comprised solely of our own staff.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – We carry Workers' Compensation insurance as required for our employees, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and protecting our workforce.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: Yes – Beverage Haven Distributors also owns Beverage Bliss Distributors, LLC, which specializes in retailing specialty wines. This ownership aligns with our focus on alcoholic beverages and compliance with industry regulations.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Beverage Haven Distributors currently does not have any other insurance policies with this company. Only one policy is listed under their account.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Beverage Haven Distributors is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; we focus solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages sourced from licensed manufacturers and wholesalers.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Beverage Haven Distributors does not rent or loan equipment to others. Our operations focus solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages, and we prioritize compliance and safety in our business practices.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Beverage Haven Distributors has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, reflecting a stable financial situation.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Beverage Haven Distributors does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages, adhering to strict safety and compliance standards.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Beverage Haven Distributors does not have any catastrophe exposure as our operations focus solely on the wholesale distribution of alcoholic beverages, adhering to safety regulations and managing risks appropriately. We maintain robust security measures and insurance coverage to mitigate potential threats.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring associated with Beverage Haven Distributors. Our commitment to compliance and ethical practices helps prevent such risks.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are currently no uncorrected fire code violations at Beverage Haven Distributors. We maintain compliance with all fire safety regulations and conduct regular inspections.
